format:

    theme: [default, ../slides.scss]

```{r}
#| include: false
# the "population": every valid stfdem answer in the ESS extract (all countries, unweighted)
dataset <- read.csv("../data/ess_lab.csv")
pop <- dataset$stfdem[dataset$stfdem >= 0 & dataset$stfdem <= 10]
mu <- mean(pop)

# 1,000 random samples of n = 100 (drawn with replacement: independent draws from the population)
set.seed(2026)
n <- 100
samples <- replicate(1000, sample(pop, n, replace = TRUE))

# each sample's mean, standard error and 95% CI = mean ± 1.96 × se (L6 s9)
means <- colMeans(samples)
ses <- apply(samples, 2, sd) / sqrt(n)
lower <- means - 1.96 * ses
upper <- means + 1.96 * ses
hit <- lower <= mu & upper >= mu

# sample 1 at the three confidence levels (critical z values from L6 s10)
z <- c(1.645, 1.96, 2.576)
w_lower <- means[1] - z * ses[1]
w_upper <- means[1] + z * ses[1]

# one bigger sample, n = 400
x400 <- sample(pop, 400, replace = TRUE)
se400 <- sd(x400) / sqrt(400)
m400 <- mean(x400)

# where each dot of sample 1 sits inside its histogram bar (fixed, so every reload looks the same)
jx <- runif(n, -1, 1)
jy <- runif(n, 0.08, 0.92)

# checks
stopifnot(
  length(pop) == sum(!is.na(pop)),
  all(diff(w_upper - w_lower) > 0),
  abs(se400 / ses[1] - 0.5) < 0.15,
  abs(mean(hit) - 0.95) < 0.02
)

# zoomed axis for the intervals: every bound shown, padded to the next 0.5
shown <- c(lower[1:100], upper[1:100], w_lower, w_upper, m400 + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se400)
axis_lo <- floor(min(shown) * 2) / 2
axis_hi <- ceiling(max(shown) * 2) / 2

# numbers for the text
f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)
miss20 <- sum(!hit[1:20])
hits100 <- sum(hit[1:100])
pct1000 <- formatC(100 * mean(hit), format = "f", digits = 1)
cover20 <- if (miss20 == 0) {
  "This time all 20 contain μ"
} else {
  paste(20 - miss20, "of 20 contain μ (red = misses μ)")
}
```

## What does "95% confident" mean? {.ci-slide}

:::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="64%"}
```{=html}
<svg id="ci-stage" viewBox="0 0 820 580" role="img" aria-label="Animated confidence intervals from repeated samples"></svg>
```
:::

::::: {.column width="36%" .ci-captions}
:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="0"}
**The population** (a teaching device)

- Treat all `r format(length(pop), big.mark = ",")` ESS respondents as the population
- Satisfaction with democracy, 0 to 10
- True mean: μ = `r f2(mu)`
- In real research μ is unknown
::::

:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="1"}
**One sample**, n = `r n`

- $\bar{x}$ = `r f2(means[1])`, $se = s / \sqrt{n}$ = `r f2(ses[1])`
- 95% CI = $\bar{x} \pm 1.96 \times se$
- = [`r f2(lower[1])`, `r f2(upper[1])`]: contains μ
::::

:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="2"}
**20 samples**

- New sample, new mean, new interval
- `r cover20`
- Misses are rare: about 1 in 20
::::

:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="3"}
**100 samples**

- `r hits100` of 100 intervals contain μ (red = misses μ)
- Over 1,000 samples: `r pct1000`%
- The 95% describes the method, not one interval
::::

:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="4"}
**Confidence level** (same sample)

- 90%: $\bar{x} \pm 1.645 \times se$
- 95%: $\bar{x} \pm 1.96 \times se$
- 99%: $\bar{x} \pm 2.576 \times se$
- More confidence → wider interval
::::

:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="5"}
**Sample size**

- n = 400: se = `r f2(se400)` (n = 100: `r f2(ses[1])`)
- 4 × n → se about halves
- Larger sample → narrower interval
::::

:::: {.ci-cap data-stage="6"}
**Takeaway**

::: {.example-interp}
- About 95% of intervals built this way contain μ
- One interval either contains μ or it does not
:::

::: {.interp-note}
Course wording (L6 s8): the "value in population likely to be within these bounds".
:::
::::
:::::
::::::

```{r}
#| output: asis
# hand the numbers to the animation (ci.html)
ci_data <- list(
  mu = mu,
  counts = as.vector(table(factor(pop, levels = 0:10))),
  means = means[1:100],
  lower = lower[1:100],
  upper = upper[1:100],
  hit = hit[1:100],
  s1 = samples[, 1],
  jx = jx,
  jy = jy,
  w_mean = c(rep(means[1], 3), m400),
  w_lower = c(w_lower, m400 - 1.96 * se400),
  w_upper = c(w_upper, m400 + 1.96 * se400),
  w_label = c("90%", "95%", "99%", "95%, n = 400"),
  axis_lo = axis_lo,
  axis_hi = axis_hi
)
cat(
  "<script>window.CI_DATA = ",
  jsonlite::toJSON(ci_data, digits = NA, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  "</script>",
  sep = ""
)
```
